critical_code_review_comments: /api/erp/* uses contractor_user dependency that returns 403 if role != 'contractor' — verified for worker, client, admin (11 guard tests).
Bill numbering uses count_documents per owner + 1 (server.py:548-549). Single-contractor safe but not concurrency-safe under high parallel POSTs; acceptable for this app. Year is from UTC now.
Margin calc divides by revenue with explicit 0-guard (server.py:521) — verified with revenue=0 estimate.
Low stock query uses $expr {$lte: ['$qty','$min_qty']} which works correctly even when min_qty=0 (verified in dashboard test).
All ERP responses exclude _id correctly via projection {'_id': 0}.
Owner-scoped queries everywhere (find/update/delete filter by owner=user.id) — cross-contractor isolation enforced.
Bills auto bill_no zero-padded to 4 digits, format BM-2026-NNNN verified end-to-end.
ERP tab visibility controlled at tab layout level via href: contractor only (frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:69) — verified worker has no ERP tab.
